name: Nautobot
description: Nautobot is a Network Source of Truth and Network Automation Platform. This helper installs Nautobot with PostgreSQL, Redis, uWSGI, NGINX, and Celery worker/scheduler services.

notes.text: The Admin and PostgreSQL passwords are generated during installation and stored in /opt/nautobot/.env with root-only permissions.
HTTP is available on port 80. HTTPS is also configured on port 443 with a self-signed certificate that should be replaced for production use.
The updater intentionally remains on Nautobot 3.x (nautobot>=3.2,<4); review Nautobot's migration documentation before a future major-version upgrade.
Nautobot requires its application files and services to run under a dedicated nautobot system account per upstream installation guidance.
ARM64 has not yet been verified, so var_arm64 is intentionally left unset in the CT script.
